facts.business: Panyam Cements and Mineral Industries Limited operates a cement production facility with a capacity of 0.66 million TPA of Clinker and 0.85 million TPA of Cement, producing 43 grade and 53 grade Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC) and Portland Pozzolana Cement (PPC).

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure on property, plant and equipment including capital advances

auditor.name: K. S. Rao & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern: The Company has accumulated losses resulting in a deficit in retained earnings of Rs 26,408.59 lakhs as at 31st March 2026, a negative net worth of Rs 23,946.61 lakhs, and current liabilities exceeding current assets by Rs 2,260.47 lakhs. The Promoters have provided a binding commitment to infuse adequate funds to meet the Company's operational requirements and short-term debt obligations.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to accumulated losses, negative net worth, and current liabilities exceeding current assets
Dependence on promoter funding commitment to meet operational requirements and debt obligations
Ongoing litigation from employees and creditors challenging the NCLT-approved resolution plan
